title: piper sempervirens
intro: Piper sempervirens, commonly known as Indian long pepper, is a perennial plant native to the Western Ghats of India. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Indian long pepper include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include piperine, pipernonaline, and other alkaloids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties.
